description: Sends one test email, from mails.ai, to the own address of an agent in forwarding mode (support@acme.com), and returns the agent. When the mail service that hosts the address forwards the test to the agent's forwarding_address, its forwarding_status becomes `verified`; a test still missing 15 minutes later makes it `failing`. While a test is on its way another call sends nothing. Needs a live key.
name: mails_agents_verify_forwarding
title: Test an agent's forwarding
